headline: As of 05:00: an internal CRM release was finished and accepted with follow-ups; the knowledge base was brought up to date.
items: Repository access was restored and queued knowledge-base filings were completed
The bot team was restructured and the bot registry updated
An internal CRM release was finished and accepted with follow-ups; it stays local-only and single-user until a security review
The internal CRM guide (English and Hebrew) and the decision log were updated
